name: The Cohera recursion
note: The loop itself is generative. There is no external generator, controller, observer, Hamiltonian or first mover. Do not add one, and do not make the closures bidirectional.

nodes.long: generative differentiation — difference, prior to data, observation, proof, study and realization
the constraint that admits some differences and not others
the realized world — what is actually brought into structure
persistent recursive organization — what survives and keeps organizing

edges.note: persisting recursive organizations modify the mechanism of selection

forbidden: reversing the causal order (data, observation or proof preceding imagination)
an external generator, controller, observer, Hamiltonian or first mover
an absolute beginning or singularity introduced to complete a pattern
